title: Declared plain explanation for one recorded answer that holds up a line
description: Maps one (fact type, value) pair to a filer-facing sentence. The projection shows it beside the declared question when a blocked line's question walk names that fact and the fact's current answer has that value: it says what the answer means for the line and what to do next. The fact type's adopted input-question citizen stays the question. Does not change the fact type, the question, any rule or any value.
